messages:
Iris: Tiny holiday idea 99: a 'sparkly cactus' ornament swap for desks. Low effort, low glitter, high charm. Who wants in? :cactus: :sparkles:

Ben: In! Will hand-make a felt cactus with a tiny pom-pom sombrero. Price cap? :grin:

Tasha: Love this. $10 cap? Also can we do a 'no real plants' rule so facilities doesn't get confused. :seedling::no_entry_sign:

Eli: In if 'sparkly' can mean sequins OR tasteful metallic paint. Also offering to be swap coordinator.

Iris: $10 cap sounds good. Swap rules: sign up by Wednesday, leave ornament on front-desk shelf labeled 'cactus swap', random matching Thursday. Remote folks can ship.

mono-bot: "Reminder: Swap sign-ups close in 2 days."

Ben: Photo: (uploaded) "felt_cactus_mockup.jpg" 
"Testing pom-pom stability." :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Tasha: GIF: <https://giphy.com/gifs/cactus-dance-3oEduSbSGpGaRX2Vri> 

Eli: I'll DM matches and post pickups. Also tiny prize: best-dressed cactus gets a tiny ribbon. :ribbon: 

Iris: Perfect. Low-pressure nonsense is officially on the calendar. Thanks team! :heart:
